notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26173621/d3a5f1633ba0b664c8792994ee72cde198d2148f.png[/img]

Blast-off has passed the 130,000 player mark today. We want to say thank you for supporting our game, thank you for playing it. It is a great honor and pleasure to see that the game is still not forgotten, even after almost 7 years after the release!

notes.title: Storm location reworked
notes.notes:
The Storm location has been reworked in this update.
The first thing you'll notice is multiple backgrounds instead of the one before. Basically, they differ only in color palette. Next, we added small static debris, which makes it easy to evaluate the vector and speed of movement. Last but not least, each burst of the storm now not only casts shadows, but also illuminates enemies, platforms, and even the boss.

notes.title: Antivirus false alarms
notes.notes:
We noticed that some antiviruses with euristic virus search think that our game is deceased with some "generic trojan".
We are check our EXE file with most popular antiviruses and all of them find no threat. (We use AV like Avast, DrWeb, Kaspersky, Microsoft, Symantec)
There is a problem with some antiviruses. We recommend to use whitelist or send a report to antivirus developer that this file is safe.

notes.title: Lowering the price
notes.notes:
Greetings!
We get several reviews from our potential players and press that points to our pricing policy. We set this price initially for purpose not-growing it after release. But community says that is’t OK to grow price after release.
Concerning that we lowering the price by half for early access. If you already buy the game and аeel insulted by this don’t be. We are ready to send you extra copy of the game or insert your name into “thanks” of game credits of your choice. All you need is to confirm your purchase.
At the same time game price will be increased after game will leave early access. 
Thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: First small update
notes.notes:
Hello! We are preparing a small update for the game that will add the missing ability "nova", a new achievement, and improved tutorial. At your request we will make the horizontal beam of death not so dangerous. It will not immediately kill the player if shields is active.

Also we have enabled a steam trading cards!

There is a known issue with crash on start game while 2 monitors in system is connected to different GPU (i.e. nVidia + Intel). We working to resolve it. Thank you!
